## Refine & Mesh

- Replaced the previous mouse-selection system with the PZero-style constraint picker. Click a segment to select or deselect it, and drag to rotate the view.
- Batched segment rendering improves responsiveness while retaining separate surface, intersection, hull and well identities. Surface and visibility filters apply to picking, and matching intersection selections remain synchronized across surfaces.
- The camera position is preserved when a constraint selection redraws the view.
- Adjusted the constraint table columns so the selection and hole checkboxes remain accessible in smaller windows.

## Pre-Tetramesh and workflow layout

- Conforming meshes are loaded automatically when opening Pre-Tetramesh, without a separate load button. Existing surface choices are preserved when returning to the tab, and stale meshes are cleared when the data changes.
- Removed the instructional overlays from the Pre-Tetramesh 3D view.
- Made the workflow tabs scrollable and added resizable splitters to the data, hull, segmentation, triangulation, pre-tetrahedral and tetrahedral views, keeping controls usable in smaller windows.

## Releases

- Successful CI runs for pushes to `main` now create the next patch tag and build the Windows, Linux and macOS release archives automatically.
- GitHub releases are published after all platform builds succeed, followed by the PyPI package. Package versions are derived from Git tags.
